title: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.40382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathematical problems, and apply frontier GPT models to a random sample of 200 of these conjectures over three passes using a reproducible protocol without problem-specific mathematical guidance. Rather than attempt expert verification of these candidate solutions, we analyze the types of problems for which LLMs produce solutions and the characteristics of these solutions. translated_title: 超越精选突破：在随机抽样的数学猜想上评估语言模型
translated_abstract: 过去一年，AI辅助数学领域发生了显著转变，前沿语言模型能够为长期悬而未决的开放猜想给出证明或反例。然而，仅研究当前这批重大突破，无法完整呈现大语言模型的真实能力以及取得已报告成果所需的计算资源。为解决这一问题，我们推出了一个新数据集 OpenConjecture，收集了自2026年2月以来发表在 arXiv 上的数学论文中的猜想。我们将这些猜想作为开放数学问题的来源，并在一个可复现的协议下、不提供针对具体问题的数学指导的前提下，将前沿 GPT 模型应用于从这些猜想中随机抽取的200个样本，共进行三轮尝试。我们并未对这些候选解进行专家验证，而是分析大语言模型能够产生解的问题类型以及这些解所具有的特征。
tldr: 该论文构建了 OpenConjecture 数据集，通过对 arXiv 数学论文中随机抽取的200个猜想进行可复现的系统评估，弥补了仅依赖少数重大突破案例来评判大语言模型数学能力的局限性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the OpenConjecture dataset and systematically evaluates frontier LLMs on a random sample of 200 mathematical conjectures from arXiv papers, addressing the bias of judging LLM capabilities based only on selected major breakthroughs.
